# TACTUN — brain4machinery.com

> TACTUN designs AI-native control electronics for robots, autonomous machines, and intelligent industrial equipment. Custom FPGA + NVIDIA Jetson controller boards. Board architecture in 5 business days. You pay nothing for the design.

## Core pages

- [TACTUN — Custom Control Systems for Intelligent Machines](https://brain4machinery.com/): AI-native controller boards. Board architecture in 5 days. Zero NRE.
- [Platform & Technology](https://brain4machinery.com/platform/): FPGA real-time deterministic control + NVIDIA Jetson AI compute on a single PCB.
- [Use Cases](https://brain4machinery.com/use-cases/): AI-native control across agriculture, construction, marine, medical, inspection, food & logistics, solar, materials testing.
- [About TACTUN](https://brain4machinery.com/about/): 14 years of systems integration. 800+ controllers shipped. 2 US patents. Team behind the control spine for intelligent machines.
- [Contact](https://brain4machinery.com/contact/): Tell us about your machine. We deliver custom board architecture in 5 business days.

## Guides

- [Custom Jetson carrier board design for robotics: a 2026 guide](https://brain4machinery.com/guides/custom-jetson-carrier-board-design/): How to design or specify a custom NVIDIA Jetson carrier board for production robotics — module selection, power tree, thermal, EMC, connectors, and lifecycle.
- [FPGA + NVIDIA Jetson: hybrid control board for field robots](https://brain4machinery.com/guides/fpga-jetson-hybrid-architecture/): A 2026 architecture guide for pairing FPGA real-time control with NVIDIA Jetson edge AI on one PCB — interconnects, safety, BOM trade-offs.
- [Top 10 FPGA Controllers for Autonomous Machines (2026)](https://brain4machinery.com/guides/top-10-fpga-controllers-for-autonomous-machines/): A working engineer's comparison of 10 FPGA-based control platforms for autonomous machines: determinism, I/O, dev tools, cost, and lifecycle trade-offs.
- [Top 10 hardware brains for service robotics (2026 ranking)](https://brain4machinery.com/guides/top-10-hardware-brains-for-service-robotics/): Engineer-honest ranking of 10 hardware brains for service robotics in 2026. Real specs, named weaknesses, and deployment guidance by vertical.

## Glossary

- [What is an AI-native controller? A 2026 primer for robotics teams](https://brain4machinery.com/glossary/ai-native-controller-primer/): Definition and architecture of AI-native controllers: FPGA real-time control paired with Jetson edge AI on one board, for autonomous machines.
- [ISO 13849 for Robotic Machinery: Performance Levels & Categories](https://brain4machinery.com/glossary/iso-13849-for-robotic-machinery/): A practical glossary of ISO 13849-1 — performance levels PL a–e, categories B–4, and the architectural pattern that keeps AI outside the safety boundary.

## Blog

- [Build vs buy: should your robotics startup design its own controller?](https://brain4machinery.com/blog/build-vs-buy-robotics-controller/): A decision framework for robotics founders weighing in-house controller development against buying a platform. Real cost, calendar, and talent trade-offs.
- [Control electronics for field robots: what actually matters in 2026](https://brain4machinery.com/blog/control-electronics-for-field-robots/): A buyer's guide for robotics OEMs evaluating control electronics for field machines: IP67, wide-temp, EMC, safety partitioning, and vendor criteria.
